results.guardian: a string in the got slot is a Whence literal, always double-quoted
results.mechanism: quote_str escapes what the lexer can read back
results.why: + = the escaper escapes MORE characters. `'` needs no escape and `\'` is not a valid Whence escape, so the rendering stops re-lexing for any string containing an apostrophe. The guardian's probe string has no apostrophe in it at all, so it cannot see this however broken the escaper is.
